scope: P10 stable music queue identity, single-item removal and drag reorder.
implemented: Every accepted enqueue receives a fresh UUID queue_item_id, including repeated copies of the same YouTube video.
Queue state carries a monotonic revision that changes on enqueue, dequeue, removal and reorder.
Removal addresses one queue UUID; reorder requires the complete UUID set and the current expected revision. Stale requests return a conflict instead of overwriting newer state.
The voice panel displays the complete queue, removes one identified item, and supports both native drag/drop and keyboard-operable ordering through the revisioned API.
remaining: Two-client browser and packaged-Windows acceptance must exercise concurrent reorder conflicts and pointer/keyboard interaction.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
